exercises.prompt: Complete the negative clause with the accusative predicate of لَيْسَ: 'Lying is not beneficial.'
exercises.explanation: لَيْسَ governs like كَانَ: its subject (الكَذِبُ) is nominative, and its predicate (نَافِعًا) is accusative.

feedback.rule: Ism laysa is marfūʿ; khabar laysa is manṣūb.

exercises.prompt: True or False: The verb نِعْمَ ('how excellent is...') conjugates across all 13 persons and tenses.
exercises.explanation: False. نِعْمَ and بِئْسَ are invariable (jāmid) verbs frozen in the past form.

feedback.rule: نِعْمَ and بِئْسَ are invariable verbs of praise and blame.
